chunks: And in the narration of ʿAbd al-Malik ibn ʿAmr, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:
He returns her, and he returns half a tenth of her price if she is pregnant.

key_terms.رِوَايَةِ: narration or reported version of the hadith
key_terms.نِصْفَ عُشْرِ: half of one-tenth, a specified financial amount
key_terms.يَرُدُّهَا: he returns her in the context of rescinding the sale

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a sold slave-woman is returned while pregnant?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning the return of a female slave sold in a transaction when she is found to be pregnant. In that case, she is returned and half a tenth of her price must also be paid back, indicating a specific financial adjustment in sales law.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3820 - In the narration of Abdul-Malik ibn Amr from Abu Abdillah (as):
"He must return her and also return half a tenth of her price if she is pregnant."
